summary: std/tls: a peer may send at most 16 records or post-handshake messages in a row that do not advance the connection (empty application data, warning alerts, KeyUpdates, tickets), as Go 1.26.11
details: a peer may send at most 16 records or post-handshake messages in a row that do not advance the connection (empty application data, warning alerts, KeyUpdates, tickets), as Go 1.26.11; KeyUpdate spam cost a key derivation each. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
